items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Frank Buck was the guy that brought all the animals over from Africa.

ctx.x: Did you ever have any train wrecks?

Oh yeah. Yeah. Once we were playing a monkey act and the monkey came out on one skate. “Due to gas rationing my partner was a little late.” So all he did was sit there in a chair while he did an act with a little dog that did all the tricks. But the act was that the owner would turn around and yell out “Frank Buck” and the monkey would go [motion]. Frank Buck was the guy that brought all the animals over from Africa.
